page.content:
The inter-realm contest that decides invasion rights.

How Mortal Kombat tournament connects

  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — The tournament is the contest the whole saga is named for.
  • Character: Liu Kang — Liu Kang won the first arcade-era Mortal Kombat tournament.
  • Character: Shang Tsung — Shang Tsung hosted the island Mortal Kombat tournament.
  • Faction: Elder Gods — The Elder Gods wrote the rules of the Mortal Kombat tournament.

What is Mortal Kombat tournament?

The Mortal Kombat tournament is the Elder Gods' contest: win enough cycles and a realm may legally conquer another. Shang Tsung hosted it for Outworld; Liu Kang won it for Earthrealm.

Key threads lead to Mortal Kombat, Liu Kang, Shang Tsung and Elder Gods.
